title: Structured Identity Milestone 1B cross-position reversal design
note: Versioned design amendment to the signed Handout 3 v1 estimand. The original pooled expected-identity estimand was rejected as non-identifiable. Sol/Hamm scientifically approved this reversal design on 2026-08-10 for Milestone 2A only: presented-identity control, R0/R1 linear baselines, grouped nulls, reversal scoring, and session/subject diagnostics.

scientific_signoff.scope: Milestone 2A positive control, R0/R1 linear baselines, grouped/exchangeable nulls, reversal scoring, session/subject summaries, and leave-one-session-out sensitivity

claims.statement: In the persisted eligible ontology rows, p2 and p3 have preceding_identity equal to expected_identity, while p4 has the exact reversal A-previous/B-expected and B-previous/A-expected.

Under the prespecified primary p2+p3-to-p4 design, requiring both p2 and p3 slots, at least three common temporal cycles, both A/B classes in each outer train/test partition, at least two valid outer folds, and at least two valid inner partitions, 5 of 15 sessions are design-supported across 3 subjects: C31o 1, V182o 3, V198o 1.
The primary supported sessions contribute 12 valid outer folds and 18 valid inner partitions; every fold is grouped by a held-out common temporal cycle and no random-trial fallback is used.

issues: Primary support is limited to 5 of 15 sessions and must be reviewed before any training authorization.
The reverse and slot-specific contrasts are secondary diagnostics; only p2+p3-to-p4 directly tests the p4 label reversal at held-out test time.
No neural feature tensor, estimator, permutation null, or model result exists for this amendment.
plan: Implement and run Milestone 2A using only the frozen five-session primary reversal corpus.
Stop if the positive control fails, tensor eligibility changes, or the reversal null cannot be constructed.
Keep M2/M3/M4 training closed until the Milestone 2A receipt is reviewed.

verification.verdict: approved_for_milestone_2a_only; primary support is 5 sessions across 3 subjects; structured-model gate remains closed

falsifier: This amendment is rejected or superseded if the canonical ontology does not reproduce the p2/p3 equality and p4 reversal exactly, if fewer than two primary sessions survive the frozen eligibility contract, or if a versioned amendment replaces the cross-position reversal estimand.
